copy.headline: Driver arrested after car crashes into Bedford business following pursuit
copy.caption:
Officers stopped the pursuit due to the risk to the driver and other motorists. A short time later, police received a call about a car that had crashed into a business.

A driver is under arrest after crashing a car into a business along Brown Trail in Bedford, police said. The crash happened overnight in the 2700 block of Brown Trail.

story.title: Driver arrested after car crashes into Bedford business following pursuit
story.summary: Officers stopped the pursuit due to the risk to the driver and other motorists. A short time later, police received a call about a car that had crashed into a business. A driver is under arrest after crashing a car into a business along Brown Trail in Bedford, police said. The crash happened overnight in the 2700 block of Brown Trail. Police said officers initially received a call about a possible intoxicated driver. When officers attempted to conduct a traffic stop, the driver fled at a high speed while crossing into oncoming traffic. Officers stopped the pursuit out of caution and due to the risk to the driver and other motorists on the road. A short time later, police received a call about a car that had crashed into a business.
